motion_system: Still by default. Hover produces a brief, localized sideways shear within the selected reflection or edge mark, then settles; reduced-motion mode remains still. No continuous pulsing or drifting vegetation.
color_drift: No global drift; preserve adjoining cobalt and lavender water regions and tightly localized warm flower accents.
glow_behavior: No emissive outlines or bloom. Apparent luminosity comes from saturated water against subdued banks.
